summary: Integer Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that its pending acquisition by KKR affiliates Armstrong Parent and Merger Sub received early termination of the HSR waiting period on September 30, 2026. The August 2, 2026 merger agreement calls for Merger Sub to merge into Integer, which survives as a wholly owned KKR subsidiary. The board unanimously recommends stockholders vote FOR the merger proposal at the special meeting scheduled October 21, 2026. Closing is expected by year-end 2026, subject to other antitrust and foreign direct investment approvals. Watch the October 21 vote and remaining regulatory clearances for deal-timing risk.
